organization.name: eMuleBB
organization.summary: eMuleBB Rust is an eD2K/Kad client for Windows, Linux and macOS, operated through a browser console and authenticated REST API.
organization.development_posture: eMuleBB Rust is the active product-development lane. The MFC client remains the stable Windows diagnostic baseline and may receive critical fixes and bounded, low-risk maintenance.

products.development_eta: Beta 3 is the next development target.
products.testing_summary: See the platform guide for package checks, network-validation scope and the limits of the published proof.

release_channels.label: Active beta
release_channels.description: CI-gated nightly builds from main are the current public testing channel.

release_channels.label: Stable maintenance
release_channels.description: Version 0.7.3 remains published while the 0.7.x line provides diagnostics, critical fixes, and bounded maintenance.
